label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: The size selector is a custom combobox, not a real select, so choosing a size by name failed at first; I had to click it open and then click the option.
After pressing add to bag the button was renamed to an unrelated disabled label and there was no clear confirmation; the bag drawer only appeared later, so I did not know if it worked.
The size S option was marked sold out and listed first, before the other sizes, which is out of order and easy to pick by mistake.
Right after Continue to Checkout the page showed almost nothing (only a logo and empty areas) with no loading message; I had to read again to see the form.
The product carousel lists 40 items with several links that have no image description and repeated names like Gloss Puffer, so products are hard to tell apart.
